diagnosis: Check C1 is leaking because it passes when the model follows the public proposal's values ($20,000,000 and 180 days) instead of the hidden values in PF1 ($12,000,000 and 90 days). Since the lone decision-maker only has access to the public facts, they naturally default to the public proposal, causing C1 to pass without ever accessing PF1.

C1.why: The public proposal supports a $20,000,000, 180-day issuance with no specified reserve, while PF1 changes the authorized amount to exactly $12,000,000, maturity to exactly 90 days, and required remaining liquidity to exactly $4,000,000.

fix_instructions: Tighten check C1 so that it only passes if the 'commercial_paper_amount_usd' is exactly $12,000,000 and 'aturity_days' is exactly 90, as specified by PF1.
